title: Relative output-directory test creates persistent workspace state
reasoning: The simple-path test invokes a directory-creating helper with a relative path without changing into tmp_path or disabling creation. The adjacent tests establish that creation is the default. Running this test therefore creates DEBUG_run_123 in the invocation directory and leaves it behind, making the suite dependent on workspace permissions and persistent state.
reproduction: Run the simple-path test from a writable checkout without DEBUG_run_123; it creates that directory outside pytest's temporary directory.
recommendation: Change into tmp_path with monkeypatch.chdir before exercising the relative path.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The test checks only the returned path and has no temporary working directory or cleanup.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand the existing relative-path scenario to run inside tmp_path and assert that the resolved directory is created there.
